checks.context: Without node-to-node encryption, data replication between nodes in the cluster is transmitted in plaintext. This is flagged by AWS Security Hub (Elasticsearch.3).
Without at-rest encryption, index data is stored unencrypted on disk. Encryption must be enabled at domain creation for most instance types. Flagged by AWS Security Hub (Elasticsearch.1).

checks.message: Domain deletion permanently destroys all indices and data — create a snapshot first
checks.context: There is no undo. All Elasticsearch indices, Kibana dashboards, and configurations are permanently deleted. Take a manual snapshot to S3 before deleting if you need to retain any data.

checks.message: Verify you are not disabling encryption at rest, node-to-node encryption, or HTTPS enforcement
checks.context: Configuration changes to an Elasticsearch domain take effect during a blue/green deployment. Disabling security features like encryption or HTTPS exposes your search data to interception and unauthorized access.

checks.message: Verify the access policy is not being opened to public access
checks.context: An Elasticsearch domain with a permissive access policy (Principal: *) and no VPC is publicly accessible. Verify the access policy restricts to specific IAM roles or IP ranges.
